$comment: Single source of truth for the version. Edit ONLY this file (or use the flags): sync-versions.js propagates "version" to seanime-web, seanime-denshi, seanime-denshi-mobile, seanime-denshi-mobile-android and internal/constants/constants.go. Scheme X.Y.Z-N: --bump-test (every test build) -> -N+1; --release-patch (update confirmed working) -> Z+1, -0; --release-minor (huge update confirmed working) -> Y+1, Z=0, -0. X/Y/Z past 15 carry into the number before them. See CLAUDE.md.

updater.notes: Auto-update is pulled from github.com/AureliusGilchrist/seaserver releases for BOTH the Go server binary and the Electron client.

themes.notes: Versioned per-theme inside seanime-themes/index.json; no global version.
